description.narrative: Das Projektland verfügt über die jüngste Bevölkerung Lateinamerikas. The project country has the youngest population in Latin America. In social practice, however, many of the young people are severely affected by political and economic exclusion and live in precarious security conditions. With 2.3 million young people not attending school, a large proportion of the population is not equipped with basic education and the necessary skills for integration into the formal labor market.
